body: بعد 5 أعوام على انقلاب قائد الجيش السوداني عبد الفتاح البرهان على السلطة المدنية، التي تشكلت عقب الإطاحة بنظام الإخوان في أبريل 2019، وأكثر من 42 شهرا على اندلاع الحرب في أبريل 2023، يواجه السودان انهيارا واسعاً في أوضاعه الأمنية والسياسية والاقتصادية والاجتماعية.

title: سد جديد وخلاف قديم.. مصر توضح موقفها من سد ميغيتش الإثيوبي
body: في أول تصريح مصري بشأن سد ميغيتش الإثيوبي، وصف وزير الموارد المائية والري هاني سويلم السد بأنه "صغير جداً"، لكنه أكد أن محدودية حجمه لا تغيّر موقف القاهرة الرافض للإجراءات الأحادية في حوض النيل، والتي تعتبرها مخالفة للقانون الدولي.

title: Saudi Arabia turns to US AI system as Yemeni pressure mounts
body: TEHRAN – Failing to protect itself and its proxies in southern Yemen, Saudi Arbia has turned to an American-AI generated system to unsuccessfully counter Yemeni Armed Forces (YAF), also known as Ansarallah.

title: Israel seizes civilian houses in al-Khalil, establishes frontline military posts
body: TEHRAN — Israeli forces have sealed every major entry point into al-Khalil (Hebron), driving more than 2,200 Palestinians out of their homes and transforming entire residential quarters into military barracks.

title: France meets second weekend of mass protests with 70,000 police, arrests 1,314
body: TEHRAN — French police arrested 1,314 people and sealed off city centers on Saturday as hundreds of thousands marched for a second consecutive weekend. Rather than addressing the root causes of the nationwide unrest, the government focused entirely on silencing the demonstrators through state repression.

title: Israeli elections: What can Palestinians expect?
body: TEHRAN — Israeli elections, scheduled for October 27, are about more than who becomes the next prime minister or whether Netanyahu stays in power.

title: Mass rally against Netanyahu government just ahead of elections
body: Three days before Israel’s first general election since the genocidal war on Gaza began, thousands of Israelis protested against the Netanyahu government late on Saturday in Tel Aviv demanding an independent inquiry into the security failures that led to the October 7, 2023 attacks.

title: Ahmadi Vafa bags silver at 2026 World Wrestling Championships
body: TEHRAN - Ali Ahmadi Vafa suffered a stunning defeat in the final bout of Men's Greco-Roman 60 kg against Japan’s Koto Gomi, losing by fall despite holding a commanding 7-1 lead, and had to settle for the silver medal.

title: Iran’s Greco-Roman wrestler Farrokhi claims gold at 2026 World Championships
body: TEHRAN – Iran’s Gholamreza Farrokhi won a gold medal at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships – Men's Greco-Roman 82 kg on Sunday.

title: Greco-Roman wrestler Ahmadi wins silver at 2026 World Championships
body: TEHRAN – Payam Ahmadi from Iran won a silver medal at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships – Men's Greco-Roman 55 kg on Sunday.
